NASB.1: Now these are [the records of] the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
NASB.2: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah and the granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
NASB.3: also Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
NASB.4: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel,
NASB.5: and Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
NASB.6: Then Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all his household, and his livestock and all his cattle and all his goods which he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to [another] land away from his brother Jacob.
NASB.7: For their property had become too great for them to live together, and the land where they sojourned could not sustain them because of their livestock.
NASB.8: So Esau lived in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
NASB.9: These then are [the records of] the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
NASB.10: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Esau's wife Adah, Reuel the son of Esau's wife Basemath.
NASB.11: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho and Gatam and Kenaz.
NASB.12: Timna was a concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Esau's wife Adah.
NASB.13: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the sons of Esau's wife Basemath.
NASB.14: These were the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and the granddaughter of Zibeon: she bore to Esau, Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
NASB.15: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau, are chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
NASB.16: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
NASB.17: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Esau's wife Basemath.
NASB.18: These are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
NASB.19: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
NASB.20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,
NASB.21: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs descended from the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
NASB.22: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
NASB.23: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
NASB.24: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah-- he is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness when he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
NASB.25: These are the children of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
NASB.26: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
NASB.27: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.
NASB.28: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
NASB.29: These are the chiefs descended from the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
NASB.30: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the chiefs descended from the Horites, according to their [various] chiefs in the land of Seir.
NASB.31: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the sons of Israel.
NASB.32: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
NASB.33: Then Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah became king in his place.
NASB.34: Then Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
NASB.35: Then Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the field of Moab, became king in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
NASB.36: Then Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
NASB.37: Then Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the [Euphrates] River became king in his place.
NASB.38: Then Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor became king in his place.
NASB.39: Then Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar became king in his place; and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.

NASB.41: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
NASB.42: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

ESV.3: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
ESV.4: And Adah bore to Esau, Eliphaz; Basemath bore Reuel;
ESV.5: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
ESV.6: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, his livestock, all his beasts, and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan. He went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
ESV.7: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together. The land of their sojournings could not support them because of their livestock.
ESV.8: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir. (Esau is Edom.)
ESV.9: These are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
ESV.10: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
ESV.11: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
ESV.12: (Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son; she bore Amalek to Eliphaz.) These are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.
ESV.13: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
ESV.14: These are the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
ESV.15: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: the chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
ESV.16: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek; these are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
ESV.17: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: the chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
ESV.18: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: the chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the chiefs born of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
ESV.19: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
ESV.20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
ESV.21: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
ESV.22: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
ESV.23: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
ESV.24: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; he is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he pastured the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
ESV.25: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
ESV.26: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
ESV.27: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
ESV.28: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
ESV.29: These are the chiefs of the Horites: the chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
ESV.30: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the chiefs of the Horites, chief by chief in the land of Seir.
ESV.31: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the Israelites.
ESV.32: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, the name of his city being Dinhabah.
ESV.33: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
ESV.34: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
ESV.35: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place, the name of his city being Avith.
ESV.36: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
ESV.37: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates  reigned in his place.
ESV.38: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
ESV.39: Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place, the name of his city being Pau; his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
ESV.40: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their clans and their dwelling places, by their names: the chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
ESV.43: Magdiel, and Iram; these are the chiefs of Edom (that is, Esau, the father of Edom), according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession.

NLT.1: This is the account of the descendants of Esau (also known as Edom).
NLT.2: Esau married two young women from Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite; and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite.
NLT.3: He also married his cousin Basemath, who was the daughter of Ishmael and the sister of Nebaioth.
NLT.4: Adah gave birth to a son named Eliphaz for Esau. Basemath gave birth to a son named Reuel.
NLT.5: Oholibamah gave birth to sons named Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. All these sons were born to Esau in the land of Canaan.
NLT.6: Esau took his wives, his children, and his entire household, along with his livestock and cattle — all the wealth he had acquired in the land of Canaan — and moved away from his brother, Jacob.
NLT.7: There was not enough land to support them both because of all the livestock and possessions they had acquired.
NLT.8: So Esau (also known as Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.
NLT.9: This is the account of Esau’s descendants, the Edomites, who lived in the hill country of Seir.
NLT.10: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah; and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
NLT.11: The descendants of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
NLT.12: Timna, the concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to a son named Amalek. These are the descendants of Esau’s wife Adah.
NLT.13: The descendants of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the descendants of Esau’s wife Basemath.
NLT.14: Esau also had sons through Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon. Their names were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
NLT.15: These are the descendants of Esau who became the leaders of various clans: The descendants of Esau’s oldest son, Eliphaz, became the leaders of the clans of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
NLT.16: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Eliphaz. All these were descendants of Esau’s wife Adah.
NLT.17: The descendants of Esau’s son Reuel became the leaders of the clans of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Reuel. All these were descendants of Esau’s wife Basemath.
NLT.18: The descendants of Esau and his wife Oholibamah became the leaders of the clans of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the clan leaders who descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
NLT.19: These are the clans descended from Esau (also known as Edom), identified by their clan leaders.
NLT.20: These are the names of the tribes that descended from Seir the Horite. They lived in the land of Edom: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
NLT.21: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the Horite clan leaders, the descendants of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom.
NLT.22: The descendants of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan’s sister was named Timna.
NLT.23: The descendants of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
NLT.24: The descendants of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the wilderness while he was grazing his father’s donkeys.)
NLT.25: The descendants of Anah were his son, Dishon, and his daughter, Oholibamah.
NLT.26: The descendants of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.
NLT.27: The descendants of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
NLT.28: The descendants of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
NLT.29: So these were the leaders of the Horite clans: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
NLT.30: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. The Horite clans are named after their clan leaders, who lived in the land of Seir.
NLT.31: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites :
NLT.32: Bela son of Beor, who ruled in Edom from his city of Dinhabah.
NLT.33: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king in his place.
NLT.34: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
NLT.35: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Avith. He was the one who defeated the Midianites in the land of Moab.
NLT.36: When Hadad died, Samlah from the city of Masrekah became king in his place.
NLT.37: When Samlah died, Shaul from the city of Rehoboth-on-the-River became king in his place.
NLT.38: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Acbor became king in his place.
NLT.39: When Baal-hanan son of Acbor died, Hadad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Pau. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.
NLT.40: These are the names of the leaders of the clans descended from Esau, who lived in the places named for them: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
NLT.43: Magdiel, and Iram. These are the leaders of the clans of Edom, listed according to their settlements in the land they occupied. They all descended from Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.

WEB.1: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
WEB.2: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
WEB.3: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
WEB.4: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
WEB.5: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
WEB.6: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
WEB.7: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
WEB.8: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
WEB.9: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
WEB.10: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
WEB.11: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
WEB.12: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
WEB.13: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
WEB.14: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
WEB.15: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
WEB.16: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
WEB.17: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
WEB.18: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
WEB.19: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
WEB.20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
WEB.21: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
WEB.22: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
WEB.23: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
WEB.24: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
WEB.25: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
WEB.26: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
WEB.27: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
WEB.28: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
WEB.29: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
WEB.30: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan: these are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
WEB.31: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
WEB.32: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
WEB.33: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
WEB.34: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
WEB.35: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
WEB.36: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
WEB.37: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
WEB.38: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
WEB.39: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
WEB.40: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
WEB.41: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
WEB.42: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
WEB.43: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

AMP.1: Now these are the records of the descendants of Esau, (that is, Edom).
AMP.2: Esau took his [three] wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the son of Zibeon the Hivite,
AMP.3: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
AMP.4: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel,
AMP.5: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau born to him in Canaan.
AMP.6: Now Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the members of his household, and his livestock and all his cattle and all his possessions which he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land away from his brother Jacob.
AMP.7: For their [great flocks and herds and] possessions made it impossible for them to live together [in the same region]; the land in which they lived temporarily could not support them because of their livestock.
AMP.8: So Esau lived in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
AMP.9: These are the records of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
AMP.10: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, Esau's wife, and Reuel, the son of Basemath, Esau's wife.
AMP.11: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
AMP.12: And Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son; and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.
AMP.13: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
AMP.14: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife, the daughter of Anah, the son of Zibeon. She bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
AMP.15: These are the tribal chiefs of the sons of Esau: The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
AMP.16: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Adah.
AMP.17: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, Mizzah. These are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
AMP.18: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the chiefs born of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
AMP.19: These are the sons of Esau, (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
AMP.20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

AMP.23: The sons of Shobal are these: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
AMP.24: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

AMP.26: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
AMP.27: Ezer's sons are these: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

AMP.31: And these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:
